behavior_constraints: Every experiment run must populate result.Metadata with env_go_version (runtime.Version()), env_os (runtime.GOOS), env_arch (runtime.GOARCH), and env_hostname (os.Hostname()) before saving
Environment metadata injection must occur in cmdRun after experiment execution but before storage Save
JSON export (export --format json) must include a top-level environment object with keys go_version, os, arch, hostname aggregating the four metadata fields
Seed determinism, SHA-256 checksums, verify, tolerance comparison, list, export, and compare must continue to work unchanged
entities.summary: This round adds environment fingerprinting by capturing Go version, OS, arch, and hostname into result metadata during cmdRun and aggregating them into a top-level environment object in JSON export.

instruction_head:
/app is the NumeriForge scientific experiment platform. Review `/app/docs/legacy_api.md` for the current interface and `/app/docs/reproducibility_spec.md` for the full reproducibility requirements.

The platform now supports seed-based determinism, SHA-256 checksums, integrity verification, and tolerance comparison.
